--- file:///.src/mapSomeCatchNoSuchElement_errors.ts ---
// @effect-v4
// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics mapSomeCatchNoSuchElement:warning
import { Cause, Data, Effect } from "effect"

class NotFound extends Data.TaggedError("NotFound")<{}> {}
class CustomNoSuchElement extends Data.TaggedError("NoSuchElementError")<{}> {}

declare const canonical: Effect.Effect<string, Cause.NoSuchElementError>
declare const withOther: Effect.Effect<string, Cause.NoSuchElementError | NotFound>
declare const custom: Effect.Effect<string, CustomNoSuchElement>
declare const mixed: Effect.Effect<string, Cause.NoSuchElementError | CustomNoSuchElement>
declare const structural: Effect.Effect<string, { readonly _tag: "NoSuchElementError" }>
declare const broadTag: Effect.Effect<string, Cause.NoSuchElementError | { readonly _tag: string }>

// MUST TRIGGER: the error channel is exactly Cause.NoSuchElementError
export const exact = canonical.pipe(Effect.catchNoSuchElement)

// MUST TRIGGER: unrelated tagged errors in the channel are preserved by catchNoSuchElement too
export const otherTaggedError = withOther.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a user error reusing the tag; catchTag matches it by _tag, but
// catchNoSuchElement only catches the real Cause.NoSuchElementError (by type id)
export const customError = custom.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the channel mixes the real error with a lookalike carrying the same tag
export const mixedLookalike = mixed.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a structural error with the same tag is not Cause.NoSuchElementError
export const structuralError = structural.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a broad string tag could also match "NoSuchElementError"
export const broad = broadTag.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// @effect-v4
// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics mapSomeCatchNoSuchElement:warning
import { Cause, Data, Effect } from "effect"

class NotFound extends Data.TaggedError("NotFound")<{}> {}
class CustomNoSuchElement extends Data.TaggedError("NoSuchElementError")<{}> {}

declare const canonical: Effect.Effect<string, Cause.NoSuchElementError>
declare const withOther: Effect.Effect<string, Cause.NoSuchElementError | NotFound>
declare const custom: Effect.Effect<string, CustomNoSuchElement>
declare const mixed: Effect.Effect<string, Cause.NoSuchElementError | CustomNoSuchElement>
declare const structural: Effect.Effect<string, { readonly _tag: "NoSuchElementError" }>
declare const broadTag: Effect.Effect<string, Cause.NoSuchElementError | { readonly _tag: string }>

// MUST TRIGGER: the error channel is exactly Cause.NoSuchElementError
export const exact = canonical.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST TRIGGER: unrelated tagged errors in the channel are preserved by catchNoSuchElement too
export const otherTaggedError = withOther.pipe(Effect.catchNoSuchElement)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a user error reusing the tag; catchTag matches it by _tag, but
// catchNoSuchElement only catches the real Cause.NoSuchElementError (by type id)
export const customError = custom.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the channel mixes the real error with a lookalike carrying the same tag
export const mixedLookalike = mixed.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a structural error with the same tag is not Cause.NoSuchElementError
export const structuralError = structural.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a broad string tag could also match "NoSuchElementError"
export const broad = broadTag.pipe(
  Effect.asSome,
  Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeedNone)
)
